name: highway
title: Highway
description: Weave through highway traffic at speed: pass close for near misses and combos, light the nitro, and earn your way up a garage of seventeen cars with four upgrades each. Driver levels open new modes, places and paints, and three missions always give the next run a goal. Four modes, five places under photographed skies.
author: pal

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the game is: engine, traffic, music.

store.tagline: Weave through highway traffic at speed

actions.title: Drive
actions.description: Up is the gas, down the brake, left and right steer; WASD too.

actions.title: Light the nitro
actions.description: Near misses fill the bar; Space or Shift burns it for speed and double points.

actions.title: Change the view
actions.description: Low behind the car, chase, the classic high angle, bumper, high, tower or long lens.

actions.title: In the garage
actions.description: Up and down pick a line, left and right change it, Enter buys, Space drives.

features: Handling built for feel: the car goes where your thumb says and stops where you let go, leaning and diving on its springs; a better car or a handling upgrade turns quicker and switches direction sooner
Traffic with drivers: they keep their distance, brake, signal and change lanes when it's safe, placed so a lane is always open
Pass close above 100 km/h for a near miss, graded by the gap you left; near misses within four seconds build a combo, and threading a gap between two cars pays a bonus
Nitro: near misses fill it, Space burns it for speed past your top and double points
Four modes: Endless, Two-Way (the oncoming side pays three times), Time Attack against the clock, and Speed Trap above a rising speed
Driver levels from 1 to 40 that open modes, places and paint collections, and three missions at a time that grow with you
Seventeen cars in five classes, City to Super, each quicker and sharper than the last; engine, handling, brake and nitro upgrades, and the garage shows what each one adds before you pay
Five places under photographed skies, from a cloudy countryside to a night run with headlights; close pal mid-run and it waits where you left it

screenshots.caption: 196 km/h through countryside traffic in the Stinger '96, the drivers signalling and keeping their gaps
The garage: choose, paint and upgrade your car, pick the mode and place; your level, the next unlock and three missions beside it
A night run: headlights on the road, tail lamps ahead, brake lights when a driver slows
Two-Way at high noon: the oncoming side pays three times, and touching it ends the run
The end of a run: the pay counted up line by line, the XP toward your next level, and how far each mission got

highway.title: Highway
